description: This file defines a React component named TasksList that manages and displays a list of user tasks, including functionality for loading, adding, updating, and deleting tasks via RPC calls to a backend service.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches tasks from the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new task, including optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: onUpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a task with optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task with optimistic UI update and error handling.
